title: AppLessons
description: Schema v7-arc — App Lessons: the shareable distillation of an Instance's change log + usage. Evidence-cited, redacted on share. See docs/spec-manifest-v7-2026-05-20.md §6.

spec_version_observed.description: Spec version under observation when these Lessons were compiled.

source_bot_id.description: Bot whose Instance these Lessons summarize.

current_summary.description: Derived narrative summary of the cited lessons[]. Not a Lesson itself; carries no separate evidence requirement, but must not introduce claims absent from the underlying Lessons.

redaction_applied.description: Must be true before publishing through the share gateway.

redaction_kind.description: Categories of redaction applied (e.g., user_quotes_paraphrased, timestamps_quantized_to_week).

evidence.description: Per-kind minimums enforced via allOf below. Each entry cites a concrete signal, count, or user statement.

proposed_spec_change.description: Advisory. Target is natural-language; Adopt phase shows to operator and re-runs full Forge pipeline.

target.description: Natural-language description of what the proposed change affects.

kind.description: Free-form change category (e.g., regex_extension, scope_expansion, threshold_tune).

source_change_log_entry_id.description: Audit link: which change_log entry on the source Instance produced this Lesson. Populated by Lessons compression (S4d); preserved across share so a downstream pod can trace the claim back.

source_timestamp.description: Audit link: timestamp of the source change_log entry.

allOf.description: blueprint_correction, failed, and worked_well require at least one quantitative-metric evidence entry.
new_capability requires at least one user_request or user_complaint evidence entry.

ref.description: Reference to the underlying signal, log line, or (post-redaction) opaque token.

value.description: Optional quantitative value for metric-type evidence.

count.description: Optional count of underlying occurrences (e.g., 3 user_requests folded into one ref).

summary.description: Optional human-readable summary; redacted at share-time.
